The '''Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufactured by the [[BramDorc Corporation]]. By [[44 ABY]], the only Colossus I known to exist was [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] ''[[Rockhound]]''.
